metadata.title: When You Get 1 Kill and Valorant Acts Like You Deserved a Medal LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just steal that kill out of pure luck?
Enemy probably hit pause on life.
If your aim’s a disaster but the killfeed’s still cheering, click now!
Valorant logic is the real MVP here.

Tap if your best plays are pure accidents you still brag about!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
